description: This file defines a feature in an ASP.NET Core application for handling the listing of tags. It includes a request query class and a query handler that retrieves tags from the database context asynchronously, returning them wrapped in a TagsEnvelope.

classes.name: List
classes.description: Container class for the List feature related classes, including the request and handler.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Async method handling the Tag list query, retrieving tags from the database and returning them in a TagsEnvelope.
